messages.text:
The best score acts strangely. A worse game can replace it, and a size I've never finished shows 0. Could you fix that and keep the rest working? Please follow the project rules.

Read docs/README.md and follow its linked requirements for this project.

Fixed both best-score issues:

- [storage.ts](/work/src/game/session/storage.ts:60) now keeps the existing per-size best when a completed game has equal or more moves.
- [GameStatus.tsx](/work/src/game/status/GameStatus.tsx:30) now shows `none` when that size has no saved best.

Type checking, all 140 unit tests, and all 77 E2E tests passed. Both changed files pass Prettier. The repo-wide format check still flags 13 unchanged files.
